    # --- liveness witness
    if out["terminates"] and out["liveness"] is not None: return "terminates but witness"
    if (not out["terminates"]) and out["liveness"] is None: return "not terminates but no witness"
    if out["liveness"] is not None:
        pre=out["liveness"]["prefix"]; loop=out["liveness"]["loop"]
        if not loop: return "empty loop"
        cur=start
        for eid in pre:
            if eid==-1:
                pass
            else:
                if eid<0 or eid>=len(edges): return "bad prefix edge id"
                s,lab,t=edges[eid]
                if s!=cur: return "prefix edge mismatch"
                cur=t
        states_seen={cur}
        for eid in pre:
            if eid==-1:
                states_seen.add(cur)
            else:
                seen2 = edges[eid][2]
                if edges[eid][0]!=cur: return "mismatch"
                cur=seen2; states_seen.add(cur)
                if is_done(states[cur]): return "prefix visits done state"
        if is_done(states[cur]): return "prefix end is done"
        loopstates=set()
        curs2=cur
        for eid in loop:
            if eid==-1:
                loopstates.add(cur); continue
            if eid<0 or eid>=len(edges): return "bad loop edge id"
            s,lab,t=edges[eid]
            if s!=cur: return "loop edge mismatch at %d"%eid
            cur=t; loopstates.add(cur)
            if is_done(states[cur]): return "loop visits done state"
        if cur!=curs2: return "loop does not close"
        # fairness
        allst=states_seen | loopstates
        labels_used={(edges[e][1] if e!=-1 else None) for e in loop if e!=-1}
        for (a,mode) in fair:
            enabled_anywhere=any(a in enb[s] for s in loopstates)
            used=a in labels_used
            every_enabled=all(a in enb[s] for s in loopstates)
            if mode=="weak":
                if every_enabled and not used: return "WF %s violated"%a
            else:
                if enabled_anywhere and not used: return "SF %s violated"%a
    return None
